title: Westwood Campus
subtitle: Westwood is a vibrant, unique neighborhood located on the west side of Los Angeles.
Westwood is famous for being the home of UCLA. The Westwood campus is located on Wilshire Blvd and Westwood Blvd. It is only 1 minute from the main bus line on Wilshire Blvd and Westwood Blvd.
It is a very fun and popular area for students and also office workers since there are many shops, restaurants and safe places to hang out.

message.title: Message from Westwood Campus
description: The Westwood campus is located in a great area near UCLA. There are various places to visit such as movies, shopping, and museums. Our TOEFL® course is very popular as many Westwood students pursue University studies. Also, our tuition is surprisingly reasonable. Many people transfer to MLI from other schools!
